title: Agnus Dei (Forestier, Missa Baisez moy)
desc: Mathurin Forestier, Missa Baisez moy, Agnus Dei, 1513–1514. 7 voices (Discantus, Contratenor, Tenor resolutio 1, Tenor resolutio 2, Tenor resolutio 3, Tenor 4, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0017_5); edited by Vincent Besson, Marco Gurrieri, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
